description: Build and run-time scaling of compiler = native, from 10^2 to 10^6 cells, against hand-written reference loops. See README.md for the result format and what each gate means.

code_size_flat.why: fusion folds a stencil's shifted reads into one group only where rows are long enough to amortize a run (fold_runs_acceptable: at most 8 runs, or at least 64 elements a run), so at the small sides, whose rows are short, the fused tape keeps up to 2 more instructions (gathers left unfolded). Bounded: fusion only merges instructions, so the fused tape never exceeds the lowered one, which is 12 instructions at every N (code_size_detail.lowered)

transport_3d.description: The 3-D limited transport benchmark (tests/bench/transport_3axis_7cubed_fullrank.esm) resized: five boundary classes per axis through expression-template matches.

code_size_flat.why: fusion folds a stencil's shifted reads into one group only where rows are long enough to amortize a run (fold_runs_acceptable: at most 8 runs, or at least 64 elements a run), so where the grid's rows are short the fused tape keeps up to 39 more instructions (gathers left unfolded; at side 5 the boundary regions are small enough to fold whole). Bounded: fusion only merges instructions, so the fused tape never exceeds the lowered one, which is 169 instructions at every N (code_size_detail.lowered)

chemistry_grid.description: The Pollu mechanism (20 species) lifted pointwise onto a lon x lat grid by operator_compose, with lon advection.

prefix_scan.description: An inclusive measure-weighted prefix scan (a filtered faq) feeding a column settling term; the layer thickness dz[i] = 100 (1 + 0.5 sin(i)) is non-uniform.

source_receptor.description: A dense square source-receptor contraction over a non-uniform matrix K[i,j] = 0.001 (1 + sin(i j)), defined in the document by that formula, so it is materialized once and read on every call. The work per call is N^2, so the ladder stops at 3162 (10^7 matrix entries).

speed.why: the work per call is N^2, so 2000 states (N = 1000) is already a 10^6 multiply-add call

regrid.description: A conservative regrid (bin-skolem broad phase, inline polygon_intersection_area) applied on every call. The overlap arrays are declared dense over source x target, so the ladder stops at 3162.
regrid.size_meaning: source cells = target cells (2 states per index)

speed.why: the ladder stops at 3162 (6324 states) because the overlap arrays are declared dense over source x target, so the default 10^4 would never check regrid at all. From 2000 states (N = 1000) a hand-loop call takes microseconds (about 3-6 us, and 10-20 us at 6324 states), long enough for a median over hundreds of calls to resolve; at 200 states it is under a microsecond and stays ungated

unstructured_gather.description: A four-neighbour indirect gather u[nbr[i,k]] over a permuted numbering of a periodic 2-D mesh; the neighbour table is an inline const array.

scalar_chemistry.description: N/20 independent scalar Pollu boxes written out as scalar ODEs. The document grows with N, so the flat-code-size gate does not apply; the ladder stops at 10^5 states.

gate_exclusions.code_size_flat: one equation per state is written in the document, so code proportional to N is the document's own size, not a compiler defect

build_slope.why: the document grows by equations, not inline data, and each binding's loader costs far more per byte of equations than per byte of data: Julia load_path about 3000 ns/byte (100..10^4 states; its per-equation schema validation and coercion, a known cost separate from the compiler), Rust serde_json parse plus typed load about 100 ns/byte (100..10^5), measured on cf30558cb, cores 18-19, two rounds. Twice that, by the same reasoning as the gate's own per_byte_ns. It excuses loading, not compiling: the rest of the build must still fit max_ns_per_state

builds.description: status is "ok": the document built under the compiler and its right-hand side ran. A refusal or error fails this gate, and every other gate is then unmeasurable for that (family, N).

code_size_flat.description: code_size is the same at every N that built.

no_steady_alloc.description: allocs_per_call is 0 bytes. On a document that built, a null allocs_per_call is a missing measurement and fails, unless the result's unmeasurable map names the field. A ledger entry for this gate states max_bytes_per_call, the most it excuses; a measure past it fails.

hand_loop_agrees.description: The hand-written loop reproduces the compiler's dy: hand_loop_max_abs_diff <= rel_tol * max(1, dy_max_abs). Guards against a wrong reference making a slow compiler look fast.

build_slope.description: (build_s(Nmax) - build_s(Nmin)) / (n_states(Nmax) - n_states(Nmin)) over the smallest and largest N that built, with Nmax <= 10^6 cells, under max_ns_per_state + per_byte_ns[binding] * (n_bytes(Nmax) - n_bytes(Nmin)) / (n_states(Nmax) - n_states(Nmin)): the build may also read the document bytes each added state brings, at twice the binding's measured load cost per byte of inline data. A document whose size does not grow with N, or a result without n_bytes, gets no allowance. Needs two built sizes.
build_slope.per_byte_ns_why: twice each binding's document load (no build) per byte of inline data, measured on regrid and unstructured_gather (the larger rate, regrid's) between the smallest and largest document of each, two rounds, cf30558cb, cores 18-19: Julia load_path 82-84 ns/byte (unstructured_gather 46-47), Rust serde_json parse plus typed load, the two steps esm_problem runs, 39-43 ns/byte (unstructured_gather 24-25). Twice: the load, plus one more pass of the same cost for the build to read the inline values out of the loaded document into its own arrays, the least a build that uses the data has to do

speed.description: steady_rhs_s / hand_loop_s <= max_ratio, in each result file (serial and threaded runs are separate files). Applied from min_n_states states up (a family's gate_overrides may lower it), below which a call is a few microseconds and the ratio measures timer noise.
